thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGERDUTY ALERT - CRITICAL - serving-prod runtime crashloop (SIGSEGV) on node gpu-12. Alert: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: @alice you are on-call for runtime (P1). Please acknowledge.

alice: acked. I'm looking. Paging runtime team. Who's near the runtime stack?

ml_runtime: here, looking now. Seeing repeated segfaults in the runtime engine (TensorRT fused path) on a handful of pods.

jordan: rolling list: pods in deployment serving-engine-canary are CrashLoopBackOff across three nodes. `kubectl get pods -n serving` shows ~7/7 restarts on each crashed pod.

alice: can you paste the latest container logs? Are we OOMing or SIGSEGV?

ml_runtime: logs show SIGSEGV. snippet:```
[2026-03-15T02:04:12Z] runtime_engine: INFO loading model weights
[2026-03-15T02:04:13Z] runtime_engine: WARN using TRT fused-kernel (quantized path)
[2026-03-15T02:04:13Z] runtime_engine: ERROR unexpected signal: 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8a2bcd
backtrace:
  tensoRTRuntime::fused_kernel_impl()+0x2f
  tensoRTRuntime::execute()+0x1b3
  runtime_server::handle_request()+0x56
  start_thread+0x7da
```

ml_runtime: also seeing a pattern: crashes spike for requests with sequence length > 2048 and when quantization flag `--use-8bit-kernel` is enabled. The recent canary pushed a new quantized fused kernel build.

liz: CS: several enterprise customers seeing 5xx for embed/generate endpoints — ticketing: ACME-254, BETA-401, SHOP-112. They're notifying support.

alice: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop routing to canary serving-engine-canary 2) scale canary to 0 or rollback 3) cordon/drain any nodes with repeated crashes 4) start fallback (CPU) nodes for high-priority customers. Who can run rollback?

infra_bot: cordon node gpu-12 -> `kubectl cordon gpu-12` executed. Drain in progress: `kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ml_runtime: initiating rollback: `kubectl -n serving set image deployment/serving-engine-canary runtime=image_registry/serving-engine:v1.4.2` (last-known-good). Pushing now.

jordan: verified CrashLoopBackOff. `kubectl describe pod serving-engine-canary-7f9d` shows repeated container exit with: `Signal: 11 (SIGSEGV)`.

ml_runtime: grabbed core dump from crashed container path `/var/crash/core.serving-engine.3245`. quick gdb backtrace:```
#0  0x00007f8a2bcd1234 in fused_kernel_process (input=0x7fffd3...) at fused_kernel.cc:412
#1  0x00007f8a2bcd0f00 in fused_kernel_impl (ctx=...) at fused_kernel.cc:98
#2  0x000055aa4b1c12f0 in execute_model (req=...) at runtime.cpp:245
```
looks like a null pointer deref in the fused kernel when `seq_len > 2048` triggers an unexpected buffer branch.

alice: good catch. While rollback proceeds, please scale route weight to 0 for canary: `console -> traffic routing -> set canary weight 0`. If console blocked, `kubectl scale deployment/serving-engine-canary --replicas=0 -n serving`.

infra_bot: scaled serving-engine-canary to 0. `kubectl scale` returned OK.

ml_runtime: after rollback to v1.4.2 and scale down, new pods coming up with stable logs. Watching for new SIGSEGVs.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by @alice. Severity P1. Current status: mitigation in progress.

jordan: started temporary autoscale: added two GPU nodes in serving-prod-gpu pool to absorb retry traffic while canary removed. `autoscaler` increased target from 12 -> 14.

liz: customers ACME, BETA, SHOP have been notified via support. CS updated status page: "Partial outage affecting text generation for some customers; mitigation in progress." Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC12345

ml_runtime: initial root-cause hypothesis: a regression in the fused quantized kernel introduced via commit 1f3b9c (canary build). The kernel uses a fast-path that assumes an initialized per-request workspace; for long sequences the allocator was returning nullptr for a resize path and not checked -> SIGSEGV. Repro locally with a crafted input (seq=4096) + `--use-8bit-kernel`.

alice: action items for now: - keep canary at 0 and rollback fully - collect all core dumps + upload to S3 (s3://redwood-incidents/INC12345/) - open internal PR revert + hotfix branch - notify product + account teams - create postmortem owner (ml_runtime + alice)

ml_runtime: uploading cores/logs: `tar czf cores_INC12345.tgz /var/crash/* && aws s3 cp cores_INC12345.tgz s3://redwood-incidents/INC12345/` done. Link: s3://redwood-incidents/INC12345/cores_INC12345.tgz

sre_lead: good. Please also run test harness that exercises quantized fused kernels across sequence lengths 128/512/1024/2048/4096 and run on PRs that touch fused_kernel.cc. Add guard checks for allocator return.

ml_runtime: will open PR with defensive check + add unit test. PR: https://git.redwood/serving/merge_requests/789 (hotfix branch: revert-quantized-fused-1f3b9c + guard)

alice: customer impact summary for incident record: ~12% of generation traffic observed 5xx for ~14 minutes while canary was receiving small traffic. Major enterprise customers affected: ACME, BETA, SHOP (CS alerted). No data exfiltration, only availability impact.

liz: status page updated with mitigation and ETA for full resolution (we'll confirm after hotfix). CS to follow up with each impacted account.

pagerduty-bot: Incident state changed to Mitigated by @alice (P1 -> Mitigated). Please confirm stable for 10m before resolving.

alice: monitoring - CPU/GPU error rates back to baseline, request 5xx dropped to <0.5% for last 5m. We'll watch for 30m. Handing off monitoring to @bob for overnight.

bob: ack. I'll watch logs/alerts and will escalate if anything reappears.

ml_runtime: root-cause summary to include in postmortem: - regression introduced in quantized-fused kernel commit 1f3b9c - insufficient allocator null-check on fast-path - not covered by seq-length stress tests - CI missed it because PR run used seq_len <= 2048 - fix = add defensive check + extend stress matrix; long-term = improve canary traffic rules for quantized kernels and add runtime guardrails

alice: created incident ticket INC12345 in internal tracker with actions and owners. Postmortem owner: @ml_runtime, reviewer: @sre_lead. Link: https://tickets.redwood/internal/INC12345

liz: drafting customer follow-up note for impacted accounts; will route through AMs before sending.

alice: final: thanks everyone. Great fast triage. We'll keep the incident open until hotfix merges and we run the extended stress tests + a controlled canary. Handoff complete to @bob at 02:30 UTC.

bob: on it. :thumbsup:
